`@interface UIDataOverlay`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataOverlay.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataOverlay.java)

Annotation that makes a UI an overlay, drawn with the screens instead of replacing them.

## Description

An overlay opens next to the current screen and stays open when the screen changes.
By default it is drawn below the screens and receives no input; `render` and `interaction` change that.
A UI cannot be both an overlay and a popup.
